payload.title: persona badge on claude
payload.body: Claude Code's status line is ONE command (settings.statusLine), with no segments to inject into, so the badge cannot be added beside a host's own status line. Two faces: when the host has no status line, install sets one that shows the running persona's mark; when it has one, install never replaces it and instead offers (wizard, or a flag) to wrap it, running the host's command and prefixing the badge. Whether the status line input names the running agent under --agent is unverified and decides whether this is possible at all without a per-persona settings file.
